Widgets Guide

Widgets are small reusable components that render data in a dashboard.

Getting Started

Install the widget toolkit with your package manager of choice today.

npm install @acme/widgets --save-exact

Configuration

Configuration lives in a single JSON file at the root of your project.

Set the theme option to control colours, density and corner radius values.

Advanced Options

Advanced options include retry policies, timeouts and cache behaviour tuning.
